title: Least-frequently-used template cache
insight: LeetCode 460 LFU Cache: hash map from key to node plus one recency-ordered list per use count and a tracked minimum count, giving O(1) get, put and eviction
prompt: The rendering service's compiled-template cache lives in cache.go and is still a stub. Please implement the Cache type as README.md specifies: fixed capacity, least-frequently-used eviction with least-recently-used tie-breaking, and constant-time operations even at 50,000 entries. Keep the package name and exported API exactly as they are, use only the standard library, and confirm that `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` succeed.
